description: This file contains utility functions for managing service worker communication, including posting messages, registering, and keeping the service worker alive, specifically for stream saving functionality in the Notesnook project.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the service worker with download data and manages message channels.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Starts the keepAlive ping to the service worker.

methods.name: findServiceWorker
methods.description: Finds the active service worker and its scope.
